description: Use as a BUYER to accept a quote. Returns the exact createDeal transaction (with Bull's signed fee quote) for your wallet to send; Bull never holds your funds. Then call bull_attach_deal with the dealId from the DealCreated event. Safe to call again to refresh the fee quote. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

payAsset.description: "base" to pay in ETH (default) or "alt" to pay in the stablecoin.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

name: bull_accept_quote
